items.snippet: 삼성SDI[006400]가 시가 기준 1조4천억원 규모의 자기주식을 소각한다.삼성SDI는 26일 이사회를 열고 보통주 333만1천391주와 우선주 17만8천400주 등 총 350만9천791주의 자기주식을 소각하기로 했다고 공시했다.이는 기존에 보유한 자기주식 전량으로, 전체 발행주식의 약 4.27%에 해당한다.소각 예정 금액은 취득원가 기준 3천451억원이다. 전일 종가 기준으로는 1조4천234억원에 달한다.소각 예정일은 오는 12월 3일이다.이번 소각은 배당가능이익 범위에서 기존에 취득한 자기주식을 소각하는 것으로 발행주식 총수

items.title: 주병기 공정거래위원장, 중소기업 만나 애로사항 청취
items.snippet: 주병기 공정거래위원장이 중소기업을 만나 현장의 애로사항을 듣고 불공정거래 관행을 개선하기 위한 정책 방향을 논의했다.공정거래위원회는 26일 영등포구 중소기업중앙회에서 김기문 중기중앙회장과 중소기업 단체협회장, 업종별 협동조합 이사장 등이 참석한 가운데 중소기업 현장소통 간담회를 개최했다고 밝혔다.주병기 위원장은 올해 중소기업의 노력과 혁신이 정당하게 보상받는 거래환경을 조성하는 데 역량을 집중했다고 설명했다.공정위는 건설 하도급 분야에서 발주자·원사업자가 파산하더라도 수급사업자가 대금을 제때 받을 수 있도록 하도급대금 지급보증 의

items.title: "AI 자금조달 금리 상승 해법은 연준 피벗…관건은 물가"
items.snippet: 증시의 급등락이 지속되는 가운데 향후 시장의 방향을 결정지을 핵심 변수는 결국 물가라는 분석이 나왔다.KB증권 이은택·이다은 연구원은 26일 보고서에서 "젠슨 황 복귀 이후에도 증시의 급등락이 지속되고 있다"며 "젠슨 황 사태가 중요한 것은 맞지만 핵심 원인은 아니었으며, 큰 그림에서 더 주목해야 할 요인은 인플레이션"이라고 진단했다.KB증권은 현재 시장이 겪는 문제의 상당 부분이 돈을 빌리려는 수요와 공급이 어긋난 '돈 부족'에서 비롯되고 있다고 설명했다.인공지능(AI) 채권과 국채, 대규모 기업공개(IPO) 등 자금 조달 수요

items.title: 퀄컴, 국내 이공계 석박사 논문 34편 선정

items.title: [美주식 23시간 D-10] 서학개미 더 늘까…"국장 메리트 높여야"
items.snippet: 사실상 미국 주식 거래가 무중단에 가깝게 연장되면서 국내 투자자의 해외 투자도 늘어나는 계기가 될지 주목된다.사실상 아시아권 투자자의 미국 주식시장 유입을 겨냥한 조치로, 국내 자본시장으로의 자금 유입을 유도할 대응 방안을 강화해야 한다는 지적이 나온다.26일 예탁결제원 증권정보포털(세이브로)에 따르면 국내 투자자의 이번 달 미국 주식 순매수 규모는 53억8천252만 달러(약 7조2천400억 원)로 집계됐다.올해 들어 지난달 전체 순매수 규모가 54억2천312만 달러(7조3천억 원)로 최대 규모를 경신했는데, 이와 근접한 수준이다

items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 26일 ‘조작수사·조작기소 진상규명 특별검사’(조작기소 특검) 후보자 추천을 마무리한다. 국민의힘이 후보자 추천을 거부한 만큼 이재명 대통령은 민주당과 조국혁신당이 추천한 2명 중 1명을 특검으로 지명하게 될 것으로 전망된다. 민주당 박성준 수석대변인은 25일 최고위원회의 후 기자들과 만나 “내일(26일)까지 특검을 추천할 예정”이라며 “2, 3명 거론됐는데 그중 한 명을 추천할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 범여권 안팎에선 한동수 전 대검찰청 감찰부장, 심재철 전 서울남부지검장 등 친여권 성향으로 분류되는 법조인들이 후보군으로 거론된다. 각 당이 후보자를 추천하면 이 대통령은 3일 이내 특검을 임명해야 한다. 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 “‘이재명 탈옥법’이라고 비판하며 장외 집회까지 하는 마당에 우리 당에서 후보자를 추천할 리 만무...

items.title: APEC때 김정은 못만난 트럼프 “러브레터 당장 시작할수도”
items.snippet: 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 집권 1기 당시 일명 ‘러브레터’로 불린 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 친서 외교에 대해 “당장이라도 다시 시작할 수 있다. 단지 지금 당장 일어나고 있지 않을 뿐”이라고 24일(현지 시간) 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령이 재취임 후 김 위원장에게 친서를 전달하려 했지만 북한이 외면했다고 보도한 최근 월스트리트저널(WSJ) 기사를 반박하며 이런 입장을 밝힌 것이다. 이날 트럼프 대통령은 뉴욕포스트와의 인터뷰에서 북-미 정상의 친서 교환 가능성과 관련해 “편지 교환이 재개되면 핵무장 문제 같은 게 언급될 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 “김 위원장은 이미 핵무기를 보유하고 있다. 빌 클린턴 전 대통령이 그를 막지 못했기 때문”이라며 과거 민주당 정권에 북한의 핵무장 책임을 돌렸다. 그는 김 위원장과 소통하고 있는지에 대해선 “최근에는...

items.title: 李 “청해부대 임무 확대… 바다 안전 무임승차 못해”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 25일 “바다 위의 위협 앞에서 가만히 있을 수도, 무임승차할 수도 없다”며 “국민의 생명과 안전, 국익을 지키는 일에 책임 있는 중견 강국으로서의 역할을 다하겠다”고 밝혔다. 청해부대의 작전구역을 아덴만에서 호르무즈 해협과 가까운 오만 남방 외해까지 약 2배로 넓히고 기뢰 제거 전력을 증파하는 파견 연장 동의안은 이날 국회 국방위원회 법안심사소위원회를 통과했다. 이 대통령은 이날 동의안이 소위를 통과한 후 X(옛 트위터)에 “우리 경제의 생명선인 바닷길과 선박의 안전을 확보하는 일 역시 국가의 중요 책무”라며 이같이 밝혔다. 이어 동의안에 대해 “기존 해군 구축함에 해상초계기와 소해 지원 역량을 더하고, 작전지역은 아덴만에서 오만 남방 외해까지로만 확대한다”며 “커지는 해적 위협에 대응해 우리 선원과 선박이 안심하고 항해할...

items.title: 공공주택 50만채중 38만채 2년뒤 착공… 전월세난 해소 한계
items.snippet: 정부가 2030년까지 수도권에 공공주택 50만 채를 착공하겠다고 25일 밝혔다. 수도권 전월세난 해소를 위해 공공 주도로 주택 공급 속도전에 나서겠다는 취지다. 이재명 대통령은 “공적 주택이 주거 사다리가 돼야 한다”고 강조했다. 하지만 50만 채 중 38만 채 이상은 2028년 이후 착공 예정이어서 실제 입주는 2030년 이후가 될 것으로 전망된다.● 전월세 대란 속 ‘공공주택’ 공급 속도전한국토지주택공사(LH)는 이날 올해부터 2030년까지 건설형 공공주택 49만7000채를 착공할 계획이라고 밝혔다. 건설형 공공주택은 기존에 지어진 주택을 매입하는 것이 아니라 LH나 LH의 발주를 받은 민간 건설사가 직접 지어 공급하는 공공주택을 말한다. 이 대통령은 이날 오후 72채 규모인 서울 은평구 응암동 신혼부부주택을 찾아 현장 간담회를 갖고 “공...

items.title: 홍익표 박사 논문, 공저자 참여 보고서 표절 의혹
items.snippet: 홍익표 통일부 장관 후보자가 박사학위 논문을 작성하면서 자신이 공저자로 참여했던 연구보고서를 표절했다는 의혹이 불거졌다. 25일 국민의힘 김대식 의원실에 따르면 홍 후보자는 2005년 ‘김정일 체제의 경제 개혁’을 주제로 쓴 한양대 박사학위 논문 일부가 8개월 전 공저로 작성한 대외경제정책연구원 연구보고서인 ‘최근 북한의 가격·유통체제 변화 및 향후 개혁과제’ 내용과 일치하는 것으로 나타났다. 북한의 ‘7·1 조치’ 이후 변화를 분석한 부분에서 소제목이 같은 순서로 배치돼 있고, 문단 배열이나 문장 단위로 같은 대목이 많다는 것. 주석까지 거의 그대로 붙여 넣기도 했다. 박사학위 논문에는 해당 부분과 관련해 대외경제정책연구원의 공저 연구보고서에 대한 출처 표시는 하지 않았고 참고문헌에만 이 연구보고서를 포함했다. 해당 논문은 홍 후보자를 포함...

items.title: [단독]부처 대변인실→국민소통실… 온라인 대응팀 확대도 검토
items.snippet: 정부가 전 부처 대변인실 명칭을 국민소통실로 바꾸고 온라인 소통 및 대응 조직을 확대하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 정책 홍보를 강화하겠다는 취지다. 정부가 검토 중인 국정 홍보 강화 방안의 핵심은 온라인 홍보와 대응에 우선 순위를 둔 인력 재편이다. 이에 따라 전 부처 대변인실을 국민소통실로 이름을 바꾸고, 부처별로 차관을 중심으로 한 정책홍보협의체를 신설하는 방안이 고려되고 있다. 다만 대외적인 대변인 명칭은 그대로 유지할 것으로 알려졌다. 각 부처의 디지털 대응팀 인력을 확충하고 조직 규모와 급을 격상하는 방안도 검토 중이다. 여권 관계자는 “허위 및 조작 정보에 대해 부처 장관이 직접 책임지고 설명하는 방식으로 변화할 것”이라고 전했다. 이에 앞서 10일 이재명 대통령이 주재한 국무회의 비공개 회의에서 문화체육관광부는 이 같은 골자의 국정...

items.title: 美, 외교안보라인 개각에 “한미동맹 협력 중요성 평가”
items.snippet: 미국 국무부가 외교안보 라인 개각에 대해 “한미동맹 내 긴밀한 협력의 중요성을 높이 평가한다”고 밝혔다. 한미 간 대북 정보 협력 문제가 제기됐던 이종석 국가정보원장과 정동영 통일부 장관 등 이른바 ‘자주파’ 인사가 퇴진하는 상황에서 한미 협력을 강조한 것. 국민의힘은 강금실 국가정보원장 후보자에 대해 “친중 반미 인사”라며 지명 철회를 요구했다. 미 국무부 대변인은 24일(현지 시간) 강 후보자와 임웅순 외교부 장관 후보자, 홍익표 통일부 장관 후보자가 지명된 이번 개각에 대해 “우리는 동맹국인 한국과 함께 미국 및 양국의 이익을 지속적으로 증진하고 있다”고 밝혔다. 각 후보자에 대해선 “한국의 각료 인사 결정과 관련해선 한국 정부에 문의해 달라”고 했다. 국민의힘은 25일 강 후보자를 겨냥해 ‘친중 인사’라며 공세를 폈다. 장동혁 대표는...

items.title: [동서남북/장영훈]내부 발탁 최 부시장, 답은 시청 밖에 있다
items.snippet: “그동안 프로젝트 중심으로 많이 했는데, 이제는 결과를 좀 봐야죠.” 취임 첫날인 23일 대구시 기자실에서 만난 최운백 신임 경제부시장은 이렇게 말했다. 이날 대구상공회의소와 대구스케일업허브를 찾아 기업인의 애로사항을 들은 그는 24일에는 국회를 찾겠다고 했다. 기업과 정치의 현장을 차례로 향한 발걸음이다. 8월 동서남북에서 ‘경제통’ 추경호 시장에게 필요한 부시장은 또 다른 경제 전문가보다 정부와 국회, 정치권을 설득할 ‘정무통’이라고 썼다. 중앙 무대에 힘쓸 거물급 인사를 기대했다. 추 시장이 오랜 고심 끝에 택한 사람은 대구시 경제 산업 분야를 두루 거친 최 부시장이었다. 시 안팎에서는 현안이 산적하고 단기간에 성과를 내기 어려워 외부 인사 가운데 선뜻 부시장직을 맡겠다는 이를 찾기 어려웠다는 후문도 들린다. 내부 발탁에 담긴 현실적인...

items.snippet: 정부가 과거 대학수학능력시험(수능)의 부정행위 의심 사례도 추적한다고 했지만 지난해 수능을 치른 시험장 10곳 중 2곳은 이미 시험지를 폐기한 것으로 나타났다. 정부는 부정행위 사후 조사를 강화하기 위해 수능 시험지 보관 기간을 현행 1년에서 5년으로 연장하기로 했다. 25일 교육부에 따르면 2026학년도 수능 시험장으로 활용된 학교 1310곳 가운데 233곳(17.8%)은 이미 시험지를 폐기했다. 나머지 1077곳(82.2%)만 수험생 시험지를 보관하고 있다. 강원 지역은 수능을 치른 시험장 44곳이 전부 시험지를 폐기했고, 인천 시험장(58.7%)과 제주 시험장(50%)도 절반 이상을 폐기했다. 서울에서는 시험장 228곳 중 52곳(22.8%)에서 시험지를 폐기했다. 반면 세종(16곳)과 경남(105곳)은 시험지를 모두 보관하고 있다. 앞...

items.title: Brightening spin- and parity-forbidden interlayer excitons through rhombohedral stacking
items.abstract: Brightened symmetry-forbidden excitons can provide critical information about the electronic structure and many-body interactions in semiconductors. Recently, interlayer atomic registry has emerged as a new way to control atomically thin layered materials in both ground and excited states. Here we show that the rhombohedral stacking in a 3R-MoS_2 homobilayer can brighten two symmetry-forbidden interlayer excitons: one is a spin-unlike 1s exciton and the other is a parity-odd 2p exciton. The nature of these interlayer excitons is revealed by their gfactors as well as the hybridization patterns observed when they are tuned to resonate with intralayer excitons. Surprisingly, the hybridized 2p exciton exhibits a constructive quantum interference between the acquired transition dipoles, revealing a hidden gauge-invariant phase contrast between the constituent electronic states. items.title: Localization of an Individual Charge Fluctuator in a Si/SiGe Spin Qubit Device
items.abstract: Charge noise from two-level fluctuators (TLFs) limits gate fidelities in semiconductor spin qubits, yet locating individual fluctuators within a device remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate a spatial triangulation method that combines the gate dependence of a TLF's detuning with the chemical potential shifts it induces in a sensing dot. Applying this method to previously reported measurements from a gated Si/SiGe quantum dot device, we use electrostatic simulations to jointly constrain the fluctuator's three-dimensional position and the magnitude of its electric dipole moment. We localize the fluctuator to a region spanning 31 nm by 1 nm laterally and 4 nm vertically within the bulk of the atomic layer deposited aluminum oxide, identifying the material hosting this individual charge-noise source. items.title: Direct generation of N00N states with layered semiconductors
items.abstract: Photonic N00N states enable phase sensing beyond the classical limit, but their generation conventionally relies on interferometric manipulation of photons using bulk optical components. Here we demonstrate the direct generation of a family of tunable two-photon polarization N00N states from a subwavelength-thick 3R-MoS2 flake. For propagation along the optic axis, the in-plane crystal symmetry allows all symmetry permitted spontaneous parametric down-conversion pathway to interfere coherently, while the large second-order nonlinearity provides sufficient brightness at submicrometer thickness without phase matching. The pump polarization sets the basis of the N00N state or equivalently a two-photon Holland-Burnett state without altering its structure or the generation efficiency. items.title: “탄핵은 헌법훼손” 일선 법원 첫 반발
items.snippet: 창원지법 판사들이 25일 “재판을 이유로 한 법관 탄핵 등 권력 분립과 헌법 질서를 위태롭게 하는 시도에 대해 깊은 우려를 표한다”고 밝혔다. 더불어민주당이 지난 19일 대법원 전원합의체의 한덕수 전 국무총리 내란 사건 판결 직후, 조희대 대법원장 탄핵소추를 추진하겠다고 밝힌 지 엿새 만이다. 법원 내부에서 판사들 비판이 터져나온 데 이어 일선 법원 차원에서 반발하고 나온 것이다. 창원지법 판사들은 이날 판사회의를 열어 ‘사법부 독립’ 안건을 논의한 뒤 “헌법과 법률에 따라 독립적으로 내린 판결을 이유로 법관을 탄핵하는 것은 사법 제도의 근간을 흔들며 궁극적으로는 국민의 재판받을 권리를 위태롭게 한다”고 밝혔다. 이들은 “재판에 대한 정당한 비판은 존중돼야 하지만, 법관의 신분에 대한 정치적 제재로 이어져서는 안 된다”고도 했다. 판사회의는...

items.title: 수능 시험지 보관 1년→5년 연장
items.snippet: 정부가 대학수학능력시험(수능) 시험지 보관 기간을 현행 1년에서 5년으로 연장하기로 했다. 지난해 수능 시험지 상당수가 폐기돼 ‘인공지능(AI) 커닝’ 의혹 규명이 쉽지 않다는 비판이 나오자 뒤늦게 개선 방안을 내놓은 것이다. 교육부는 25일 자료를 내고 이런 방향으로 시험지 보관 관련 규정을 개정하겠다고 밝혔다. 교육부에 따르면, 지난해 11월 13일 치러진 2026학년도 수능 시험장 1310곳 가운데 233곳(17.8%)이 수능 시험지를 폐기한 것으로 나타났다. 현재 교육부 지침에는 시험장 학교는 1년간 시험지를 의무적으로 보관해야 하고, 이후에 자율적으로 폐기할 수 있다. 강원도는 지난해 수능 시험지를 모두 폐기했고, 인천은 시험장 학교 63곳 중 37곳(58.7%), 서울은 228곳 중 52곳(22.8%)이 시험지를 없앴다. 전북과 제...

items.title: 노란봉투법, 로펌만 배 불렸다... 불복 소송이 타결의 3배
items.snippet: 정부가 올 3월부터 노사 간 대화 촉진과 원·하청 이중 구조 완화 등을 내걸고 노란봉투법을 시행했지만, 정작 현장에서는 대화와 합의보다는 법정 다툼이 더 많은 것으로 확인됐다. 노사 합의에 이른 사업장은 14곳인 반면, 원청이 하청 노동자의 ‘진짜 사장’에 해당하는지를 판단한 노동위원회 판정에 불복해 제기된 행정소송은 45건에 달했다. 합의가 이뤄진 사업장의 세 배 넘는 수준이다. 이 때문에 “하청 노동자의 처우를 개선하겠다면서 만든 법의 최대 수혜자는 로펌”이란 말까지 나오고 있다.

items.title: “교사냥이 출몰 막아라”… 임용고사 시험장에 열화상·금속·전파 탐지기 투입
items.snippet: 오는 28일 전국적으로 실시되는 공립 중등 임용고사에도 ‘인공지능(AI) 커닝’ 비상이 걸렸다. 교사를 뽑는 시험 관리가 허술하다는 지적이 나오면서 시도 교육청들은 각종 대책을 내놓고 있다. 25일 교육부에 따르면, 2027학년도 공립 중등 교사 임용 1차 시험에는 6404명 모집에 4만3914명이 지원해 6.86대1의 경쟁률을 기록했다. 경쟁이 치열한 만큼 수험생들의 ‘커닝’ 불안감도 높다. 한 대학에서 교직 과정을 밟고 있는 예비 중등 교사 정모씨는 지난 18일 전국 16개 시·도 교육감을 상대로 위헌 확인 소송을 제기한 데 이어, 시험일 지정 효력정지 가처분 신청까지 냈다. 중등 교사 임용 1차 시험의 AI 부정행위 방지 대책이 부실해 기본권이 침해됐다는 이유다.

items.title: “사고력 평가 아닌 탈 안나는 문제만… 수능, AI가 잘 푸는 시험 돼”
items.snippet: “대학수학능력시험은 한 문제로 인생이 갈리는 시험이 아니라, 고교 교육을 제대로 마쳤는지 확인하는 시험이어야 합니다.” 김창원(64) 경인교대 국어교육과 교수는 24일 본지 인터뷰에서 “수능도 처음에는 기본 사고력을 중심으로 평가했다. 원래 취지를 다시 돌아봐야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 김 교수는 2019학년도 수능 총괄 검토위원장을 맡았고, 2026학년도 수능 출제위원장을 지냈다. 2019학년도 수능에선 역대급 킬러 문항으로 꼽히는 ‘국어 31번’ 때문에 큰 비판을 받았고, 2026학년도엔 절대평가 과목인 영어가 지나치게 어렵게 출제돼 수험생들이 큰 혼란을 겪었다. 이를 모두 겪은 김 교수는 “수능이 30여 년간 운영되면서 출제진이 정답 시비를 걱정해 ‘탈이 나지 않을 문제’만 내다 보니 오히려 인공지능(AI)이 쉽게 푸는 시험이 됐다”면서...

items.title: 지진은 어린이라고 봐주지 않아요
items.snippet: 25일 전남광주시 북구청 직장 어린이집에서 아이들이 지진 대피 훈련을 하고 있다. 두 손으로 안전모를 감싸 쥔 채 책상 밑에 엎드렸다. 이 어린이집은 ‘경주 지진’ 발생 10년을 맞아 이번 훈련을 실시했다고 밝혔다. 2016년 9월 발생한 경주 지진은 규모 5.8로 국내 지진 관측 사상 가장 강력했다.

items.title: ‘가면’ 벗겨지자 세상 등진 그들… 리플리 증후군 앓았나
items.snippet: 올해 7월 치른 법학적성시험(리트·LEET) 만점자 이진우(32)씨는 지난해 대학수학능력시험에서 1문제만 틀려 서울대 치대에도 입학했다. 그런 이씨는 리트에서 만점을 받은 뒤로 수험기를 유튜브와 언론 인터뷰, 강연 등을 통해 알려왔다. 이달 들어 세무사 시험 수석 합격자가 인공지능(AI)을 이용해 부정행위를 했다는 의혹이 불거지자 이씨는 수능 문제를 실시간으로 풀어 실력을 입증하겠다고 했다. 그런데 자기 성적 알리기에 적극적이었던 이씨는 수능 당일인 지난 19일 공개 검증 자리에 나오지 않았고 서울 한 모텔에서 숨진 채 발견됐다.

items.title: 노소영측, 최태원 화해권고 거부
items.snippet: 노소영 아트센터 나비 관장이 25일 최태원 SK그룹 회장이 제안한 이혼 재산 분할 화해권고 요청을 거부했다. 최 회장 측은 지난 23일 파기환송심에서 노 관장에게 지급하라고 판결한 재산 분할금 9440억원을 모두 현금으로 지급하겠다며 대법원에 화해권고를 요청했었다. 노 관장이 최 회장의 화해 요청을 거부함에 따라 이 사건은 대법원의 재상고심 판결로 최종 확정될 전망이다. 최 회장 측은 지난 23일 재산 분할 재상고심을 맡은 대법원 2부(주심 김성수 대법관)에 ‘파기환송심에서 산정한 재산 분할액인 9440억원을 모두 내겠다’며 화해권고 결정을 요청했다. 화해권고는 재판부가 직권으로 소송 당사자에게 합의를 권고하는 절차다. 당사자들이 화해권고 결정문을 받고 2주간 이의를 제기하지 않으면 확정 판결과 같은 효력이 생긴다.

items.title: 한양도성 세계유산, 서대문구까지 반발
items.snippet: 국가유산청과 서울시가 한양도성 세계유산 등재를 추진 중인 것과 관련해 서울 서대문구도 “재개발 사업에 차질이 생길 수 있다”며 반발하고 나섰다. 서대문구는 홍제동 개미마을, 옛 홍제4구역 등 재개발 지역 주민 1308명 서명을 받아 유산청과 서울시에 제출했다고 25일 밝혔다. 박운기 구청장은 “세계유산 등재라는 공익적 가치를 위해 특정 지역 주민들의 일방적 희생을 요구해서는 안 된다”고 했다. 그동안 중구와 용산구가 반발해 왔는데 서대문구까지 가세한 것이다. 박 구청장은 더불어민주당 소속이다. 민주당 소속 구청장이 공식적으로 문제를 제기한 것은 이번이 처음이다.

items.title: ‘진료과목 피부과’ 보고 갔는데 일반의… ‘전문의 표시 의무화’ 입법 추진
items.snippet: 경기도에 사는 김모(64)씨는 최근 피부 문제로 상담을 받기 위해 동네 의원을 찾았다. 의원 간판엔 분명 ‘진료 과목 피부과’라고 돼 있었다. 그런데 진료를 받고 돌아온 뒤, 자신을 진료한 의사가 피부과 전문의 자격이 없는 일반의라는 사실을 알게 됐다. 김씨는 “당연히 피부과 전문의인 줄 알았는데, 뭔가 속은 기분이었다”고 했다. 현행법상 피부과 전문의가 아니면 ‘○○피부과의원’이란 명칭은 쓸 수 없다. 하지만 ‘○○의원, 진료 과목 피부과’라고 표시할 순 있다. 의사 면허만 있으면 전문의 자격이 없어도 피부과 진료를 할 수 있기 때문이다. 이는 다른 진료과도 마찬가지지만, 특히 최근 젊은 의사들이 많이 진출하는 피부·미용 분야에서 전문의 자격을 둘러싼 혼란이 크다는 지적이 나온다.

items.title: 어린이 ‘응급실 뺑뺑이’ 뒤엔, 무너져가는 소아 중환자실 있었다
items.snippet: 지난달 28일 오전 11시 서울 종로구 서울대병원 어린이병원 소아 중환자실(PICU). 선천성 심장병을 갖고 태어난 생후 2개월 영아, 이식 수술 직후 면역력이 극도로 떨어져 격리 치료를 받는 환아 등이 생명 유지 장치를 단 채 병상에 누워 있었다. 한쪽에서는 폐 기능이 급격히 나빠진 환아에게 에크모(ECMO·체외막 산소 공급 장치)를 삽입하는 응급 시술을 앞두고 의료진이 분주하게 움직였다.

items.title: 정일문·김인호 ‘자랑스러운 단국인’
items.snippet: 단국대 총동창회(회장 고정용)는 ‘2026 자랑스러운 단국인’에 정일문 한국투자증권 부회장과 김인호 단국대 석학교수를 선정했다. 정 부회장은 한국투자증권 공채 출신으로 대표, 부회장까지 올랐다. 금융투자협회 비상근 부회장 등으로도 활동하고 있다. 김 교수는 2000년부터 단국대에서 동물생명공학을 연구해 왔다. 2024년 단국대 제1호 석학교수로 임명됐다. 시상식은 다음 달 3일 ‘단국대 총동창회 송년의 밤’ 행사에서 열린다.

items.title: [플라자] 장학재단, 같이 함께
items.snippet: 장학재단 같이함께(이사장 안대희 전 대법관)는 25일 서울 종로구 서원빌딩 사무실에서 2026년 하반기 장학금 수여식을 갖고 수용자 자녀 및 범죄 피해자, 교정 공무원 자녀 등 18명에게 4500만원을 전달했다. 같이함께는 2014년 설립돼 수용자 자녀 등이 경제적 어려움으로 학업을 포기하지 않도록 지원하는 일 등을 해오고 있다.

items.snippet: ▲ 박진식 前 진주남중 교장 별세, 정무영 남편상, 박준태 · 박성림 · 박시후 부친상, 정희선 시부상=24일22시37분 경남 진주 한일병원, 발인 26일10시20분, (055)756-9009 ▲ 서영옥 별세, 김찬희 남편상, 서효원 前 한국머스크 수석매니저· 서정욱 · 서혜원 부친상, 앤서니 헤가티 DSRM 대표· 류철호 뉴데일리 부국장 장인상, 석정원 시부상=24일12시11분 대구 파티마병원, 발인 27일7시, (053)958-9000

items.title: 30년간 우크라·몽골·말라위서 봉사, 강지헌·주수경 부부 ‘제38회 아산상’
items.snippet: 아산사회복지재단(이사장 정몽준)이 25일 우크라이나·몽골·말라위에서 30년간 의료·교육 봉사를 펼친 강지헌(66)·주수경(66) 부부에게 제38회 아산상(상금 3억원)을 시상했다. 치과의사인 강씨는 1996년 우크라이나로 건너가 의료 취약지 주민들을 진료했고, 2001년 이후에는 몽골·말라위에서 의료 봉사 등을 이어왔다. 아내 주씨는 현지 아동·여성 교육에 앞장섰다.

items.title: 손정의 회장, 대구 조상 묘소 비공개 참배
items.snippet: 손정의(일본명 손마사요시) 소프트뱅크 회장이 지난달 9일 대구 동구에 있는 조상 묘소를 비공개로 참배한 사실이 뒤늦게 알려졌다. 25일 일직 손씨 문중에 따르면, 손 회장이 조상 묘소를 찾은 것은 이번이 처음이다. 손 회장은 삼촌과 문중 관계자, 통역관 등과 함께 묘소를 찾았다. 1시간 30분가량 머물며 고조모와 증조부, 작은증조부 묘소에 차례로 절을 올렸다.

items.title: U.S. army says detonation of bomb chemicals in Iowa a success despite toxic plume concerns
items.snippet: The U.S. Army intentionally blew up the nation's entire stockpile of lead azide, a chemical used to make explosives, saying the first checks show Wednesday's controlled detonation in Iowa didn't spread toxic dust to nearby homes and farms.

items.title: [Dr.이은봉의 의학 연구 다이제스트] 야근할 때 ‘야식’ 먹으면 우울·불안 증가
items.snippet: 인간에 내재된 생체리듬은 밤에는 잠을 자고 낮에는 깨어서 일상생활을 하도록 한다. 하지만 회사 일 등으로 어쩔 수 없이 야근을 해야 하는 경우는 정상적인 생체리듬과 생활리듬간에 괴리가 발생한다. 지속적인 야간 근무는 기분 변화도 일으켜서, 우울증이나 불안증 발생 빈도를 25~40% 높이는 것으로 알려져 있다. 최근 하버드대 연구팀은 야간 근무 시 식사가 우울감이나 불안증에 어떤 영향을 미치는지를 조사해서 미국국립과학원회보(PNAS)에 보고했다.

items.title: ‘먼지 필터’ 코로만 숨 쉬어야 건강 지킨다
items.snippet: “코로 호흡이 어려우면 입으로 숨 쉬면 되지 않을까?” 박인출 치의학 박사는 이에 대해 “잘못된 정도를 넘어 굉장히 위험한 생각”이라고 했다. 조선일보 의학·건강 유튜브 ‘김철중의 이러면 낫는다’는 박인출 박사와 함께 숨만 잘 쉬어도 건강해진다는 ‘숨길 의학’에 대해 알아봤다.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [재밌다, 이 책] 삶에 없어선 안 될 여섯 물질은 뭘까요?
items.snippet: 에드 콘웨이 지음｜이종인 옮김｜출판사 인플루엔셜｜가격 2만9800원

items.title: 집 주변에 숲·산책로 많으면 더 자주 걷게 돼 사망률 낮아
items.snippet: 집 주변에 숲과 녹지가 많으면 주민들이 걷기를 더 많이 하고, 그런 환경 속에서 걷기를 많이 하는 지역일수록 사망률이 낮게 나타난다는 국내 연구 결과가 나왔다. 건강을 유지하려면 개인의 운동 노력뿐 아니라 일상적으로 몸을 움직이게 만드는 거주 환경도 중요하다는 의미다. 충북대의대 예방의학교실 엄상용 공동 연구팀은 전국 228개 행정구역을 대상으로 도시 숲의 면적 비율과 주민들의 걷기 실천율, 연령표준화 전체 사망률의 관계를 분석한 연구 결과를 국제학술지 ‘사이언티픽 리포트’ 최근 호에 발표했다.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [뉴스 속의 한국사] 왕 죽인 독재자이자 전쟁 영웅… 두 얼굴 지녔어요
items.snippet: 최근 방영을 시작한 KBS 대하사극 ‘문무’는 삼국 시대 말기의 통일 전쟁을 소재로 한 드라마입니다. 그런데 주인공인 김법민(훗날의 신라 문무왕)보다 시청자들에게 더 주목받은 인물은 고구려의 연개소문(?~665)입니다. 연개소문 역을 맡은 배우가 연개소문이 정변을 일으켜 권력을 장악하는 과정을 뛰어나게 연기했기 때문이죠. 오늘은 최근 주목받는 고구려 말의 정치가이자 장군 연개소문에 대해 살펴보겠습니다.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [한입 테크 사전] AI 계산만 전문으로 하는 반도체… 감자 깎기에 특화된 감자칼과 같아요
items.snippet: 최근 구글이 새로운 인공지능(AI) 칩 ‘TPU 8tx’와 ‘TPU 8i 맥스’를 공개했어요. 지난 4월 내놓은 두 제품까지 더하면 올해에만 TPU(텐서 처리 장치)를 네 종류나 선보인 셈이죠. TPU는 AI를 만들고 돌리는 데 딱 맞춘 전용 칩이에요. 이렇게 AI 계산만 전문으로 하는 칩을 보통 NPU라고 불러요. ‘신경망 처리 장치(Neural Processing Unit)’의 줄임말로 AI의 바탕인 인공신경망 계산을 전문으로 처리하는 칩이에요.

items.title: 피 쏟는 산모 살려라… 자궁출혈 막는 건국대병원 어벤져스
items.snippet: 경기도 김포에 사는 33세 여성은 태아 기형으로 임신을 종결한 뒤 심각한 자궁출혈이 발생했다. 일산의 한 대학병원에서 치료받았으나 자궁출혈을 막기 위한 자궁동맥색전술을 시행하기 어려운 상황이었다. 색전술은 혈관조영술을 통해 출혈을 일으키는 자궁동맥을 막아버리는 영상의학과 중재 시술을 말한다. 결국 환자가 이송된 곳은 한강을 따라 서울 동쪽에 자리 잡은 건국대병원. 이곳 의료진이 자궁동맥색전술로 출혈을 가까스로 막아 산모를 살렸다.

items.title: 초고령화와 함께 심방세동 늘자… 펄스장 절제술 뜬다
items.snippet: 초고령사회 진입과 맞물려 최근 심방세동 환자가 급증하고 있다. 이는 비정상적인 전기 신호로 인해 심장의 위쪽 좌심방이 빠르고 불규칙하게 떨리는 부정맥을 말한다. 대한부정맥학회가 2024년 발표한 실태 연구에 따르면, 우리나라 성인의 심방세동 유병률은 2013년 1.1%에서 2022년 2.2%로 두 배로 늘었다. 이에 심방세동을 진단받은 유병 환자는 94만여 명에 이른다. 새롭게 진단받는 사람도 늘어나, 60세 이상 인구의 심방세동 유병률은 3.9%에서 5.7%로 높아졌다.

items.title: 주북 中대사, 北외무성 부상 만나 “내년에도 교류·협력 확대”
items.snippet: 왕야쥔 주북 중국대사가 25일 김명수 북한 외무성 부상을 만나 내년에도 북중 정상 간 합의를 바탕으로 교류와 협력을 확대하겠다고 밝혔다.주북 중국대사관에 따르면 왕 대사는 이날 평양 대사관에서 “양국 정상이 1년 사이 서로 방문해 양국 관계가 새로운 역사적 단계에 들어섰다”고 말했다.김 부상은 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 6월 방북과 김정은 북한 노동당 총비서의 지난달 중국 단둥 방문을 두고 “피로 맺은 조중(북중) 우의가 굳건하다는 점을 전 세계에 보여줬다”고 말했다. 그는 중국 외교부 등과 협력을 강화하겠다는 뜻도 밝혔다.북중은 지난해 9월 베이징과 올해 6월 평양에서 잇달아 정상회담을 열며 관계 복원에 속도를 냈다. 지난달 15일에는 북한 신의주와 중국 랴오닝성 단둥을 잇는 신압록강대교가 완공 12년 만에 개통됐다. 김 총비서는 9일 뒤 이...

items.title: AFM metrology for 3D high aspect ratio semiconductor structures
items.abstract: Transistors have long been the foundation of the semiconductor industry, with continuous architectural innovations enabling the scaling of integrated circuits while maintaining high performance. Advancements in deposition and lithographic techniques have further expanded design possibilities, while increasing structural complexity demands stricter process control. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) offers a rapid and reliable metrology solution, providing high-resolution measurements and robust statistical analysis of critical parameters. In this work, we present clearly resolved individual profiles of lines and spaces in high aspect ratio (HAR) gate all around FET (GAAFET)-type structures on both the nanosheet (NS) region and in the isolation region between the nanosheets and we present a comprehensive statistical evaluation of their critical dimensions.

High-Precision Photometry with a scientific CMOS Camera: III Lab and on-Sky testing of Andor Toran-26B
items.abstract: Scientific CMOS cameras are increasingly used in modern astronomy, offering CCD-like performance with lower power use, faster readout, and reduced cost. We evaluate the photometric precision of the Toran-26B camera, featuring the IMX571 sensor from Sony, a new CMOS camera from Andor Technology, through laboratory and on-sky tests in its two modes: high well capacity (HWC) and low noise (LN). Key metrics include read noise, dark current, photo and dark signal non-uniformity, quantum efficiency, and window transmittance. The median read noise is 1.07\,e$^-$ (LN) and 2.79\,e$^-$ (HWC). Bias shows minor dark signal non-uniformity: 0.076\,e$^-$ (LN), 0.173\,e$^-$ (HWC). Pixel well depth reaches 15700\,e$^-$ (LN) and 50000\,e$^-$ (HWC), with dynamic ranges of 83.39\,dB and 85.05\,dB, respectively. items.title: Real-Time Cryo-CMOS Photon-Number Readout from a Single SNSPD
items.abstract: Measurements leveraging the intrinsic photon-number resolution of Superconducting Nanostrip Single-Photon Detectors (SNSPDs) have recently gained traction due to the simplicity of the detector design. Intrinsic photon-number measurement schemes using SNSPDs encode the photon-number information in picosecond signal timing; these systems thus require high bandwidth readout and sensitive electrical measurement equipment. We show a cryogenic electronic circuit operating close to the SNSPD in the cryostat, which can isolate single-photon detection events directly from the SNSPD signal. This reduces the latency of the photon-number readout to (13.9 $\pm$ 0.3) ns, which enables feedforward operations based on intrinsic photon-number measurements with low latency.

items.title: Bayesian Calibration of Effective Material Parameters in Electric Machine Stators
items.abstract: Efficiency-driven faster switching by wide-bandgap semiconductor devices increases electromagnetic interference (EMI) in electric vehicles (EVs). Mitigating this EMI becomes more complex as system components grow. Therefore, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) is assessed early via system-level simulation of the EV powertrain. A key EMC-critical quantity is the impedance of the electric drive machine, forming a major part of the EMI propagation path. Finite element (FE) simulations are typically used but are computationally expensive and limited by insufficient material property knowledge. We present a surrogate model based Bayesian calibration framework for 3D full-wave FE simulation of an externally excited synchronous motor (EESM) stator. items.title: Revisiting the Schottky-Mott Relation for Metal/ Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Interfaces: The Role of Interface Dipoles
items.abstract: High contact resistance, predominantly stemming from Fermi-level pinning (FLP), becomes a critical bottleneck in the contact engineering of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) based two-dimensional field-effect transistors (2DFETs). Our study re-examines the inherent nature of FLP in 2D semiconductors, particularly focusing on regimes where the material thickness is commensurate with the interface thickness. Through the synergistic application of first-principles calculations and experimental validation via ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS) and scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS), we rigorously establish the metal effective work function (eWF) as the definitive figure of merit for substantiating the Schottky-Mott relation. Our findings indicate that FLP is intrinsically governed by both long-range dipole interactions and extended short-range Lennard-Jones potentials. Thi...

items.title: Self-Assembled Triangular Sc-rich Nanodomains: The Orign of Anomalous Alloy Scattering in ScAlN/GaN Heterostructures
items.abstract: Wurtzite scandium aluminium nitride (ScAlN) alloys hold substantial potential for GaN heterostructure high-electron mobility transistors, owing to their large spontaneous polarization gradient and the ability to achieve precise lattice matching at heterointerface. Nevertheless, despite continuous advances in epitaxy and device fabrication, the two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) mobility in ScAlN/GaN heterostructures remains persistently limited, and the underlying microscopic origin remains elusive. Here, we uncover an anomalous electron scattering mechanism from laterally correlated alloy disorder that spontaneously develops within the ScAlN barrier driven by strain-field undulations imposed by threading dislocations. items.title: Carrier relaxation confines the Bogdanov--Takens degeneracy of an optically injected semiconductor laser
items.abstract: Optically injected semiconductor lasers are forced nonlinear oscillators whose locking boundaries are organized by codimension-two points. We ask which property of the carrier balance permits or forbids a Bogdanov--Takens (BT) point in the standard three-dimensional rate equations. Taking the carrier inversion $n$ as distinguished observable, the rate that enters the spectral conditions is the slope of the gain--loss balance, $ξ=\partial\dot n/\partial n=-2Γ/κ$, where $Γ$ is the damping of the relaxation oscillation and $κ=1+2Bn$ the normalized stimulated-emission factor. The two BT conditions become affine in $ξ$ and imply the exact sum rule $K^{2}=I[1-(1+κ)I]$ between injection amplitude $K$ and intracavity intensity $I$. items.title: From Entropy Source to Stochastic Bit-Stream: Low-Cost Converters for True-Random Stochastic Computing
items.abstract: Stochastic computing (SC) encodes values as the probability of ones in random bit-streams, which allows arithmetic circuits with very low area and power and a natural tolerance to faults. The accuracy and security of an SC system depend on the quality of those bit-streams. Conventional generators build them from pseudo-random or quasi-random sequences, which are predictable, periodic, and correlated across streams drawn from the same generator. This work proposes three methods for converting the unbiased outputs of a true random number generator (TRNG) into stochastic bit-streams (SBS) with arbitrary target probabilities: a block extraction and comparison circuit, a counter-logic circuit, and a cascaded majority-logic pipeline. All three accept bits from any true- random source and are built from standard CMOS logic. They reach the accuracy of a software random generator for both indepen...

items.title: A scalable dense silicon qubit architecture with logical operations
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) requires a large number of physical qubits to encode logical qubits with sufficiently low error rates. Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform because of their small footprint, compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing technologies, and demonstrated high-fidelity operations. However, realizing a scalable architecture that supports quantum error correction, qubit transport, wiring, and logical gate operations remains a major challenge. Here, we propose a scalable dense silicon spin qubit architecture designed to support large-scale FTQC. The architecture consists of qubit memories, data qubit lanes, and cross junctions. Qubit memories store logical qubits encoded using the rotated surface code and support logical single-qubit operations. items.title: Low-barrier-height Hf$_\text{1-x}$Zr$_\text{x}$O$_2$ ferroelectric tunnel junctions with large ON-state currents
items.abstract: Ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) hold great promise for nonvolatile memory, neuromorphic computing, and other applications. Hf$_\text{1-x}$Zr$_\text{x}$O$_2$ (HZO) has become a leading candidate for the tunnel barrier due primarily to its compatibility with CMOS technology. Recent advances on HZO based FTJs have highlighted the importance of understanding the electrical transport through a ferroelectric tunnel barrier for fulfilling the technological promises of FTJs. In this paper we report investigation of HZO FTJs featuring a barrier of ultrathin HZO ($\leq$5nm) measured down to a temperature of 2 K. Direct quantum tunneling was found to dominate at low temperatures, along with contributions from trap-assisted tunneling. As the temperature increases, conduction by thermal activation takes over. We developed a minimal model that accounts for all experimental observations, revealin...

items.title: Physics-Based TCAD Modeling of Nanowire Cryotrons with Coupled Superconducting and Thermal Dynamics
items.abstract: Nanowire cryotrons (nTrons) provide gate-controlled superconducting switching, current gain, and high-impedance outputs for cryogenic computing, detector readout, and superconductor-semiconductor interfaces. We develop a physics-based Sentaurus TCAD framework that couples time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau dynamics, separate electron and phonon energy equations, and mixed-mode circuit simulation. Superconducting terminal-current corrections connect the custom solver to the native electrical solution, linking local suppression of superconductivity, heating and cooling, and current redistribution in the external circuit. To our knowledge, this is the first Sentaurus-based mixed-mode TCAD implementation for nTrons. items.title: Unveiling ferroelectricity in wafer-scale beta-phase In$_2$Se$_3$
items.abstract: Pushing ferroelectricity to the ultimate thickness limit is a central challenge for memory hardware, because conventional three-dimensional ferroelectrics degrade through depolarization and interfacial effects when thinned. Here we identify $β$-In$_2$Se$_3$, a van der Waals semiconductor regarded as centrosymmetric, as a host of bistable polar order arising from a picometre-scale distortion within each quintuple layer. The polar state has out-of-plane and in-plane components, is switched by a vertical electric field, and persists to the bilayer limit (~1.9 nm) with an estimated coercive field of 0.9 MV/cm and an apparent remanent polarization of 11.0 $μ$C/cm$^2$. Films grown by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition on 2-inch wafers yield capacitor arrays with a switching-voltage spread below 5% across 100 devices, an endurance of $10^7$ cycles and a projected ten-year retention. items.title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
items.abstract: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. items.title: A library-based approach for inverse reconstruction of cavity depth using angle-resolved cathodoluminescence
items.abstract: In nanofabrication processes, accurate metrology is a crucial step for obtaining control over the required critical dimensions in a device. Traditionally, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is used to obtain high resolution measurements of the lateral dimension, but obtaining depth information on a thick sample is more complex. In this work, we use angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (AR-CL) spectroscopy to resolve this third dimension. Using 30 keV electrons in the SEM, CL is created at the bottom of a micrometer scale cavity milled in a gold surface. We show that reflections of the CL off the cavity sidewalls produce an interferogram which is a sensitive probe for the cavity geometry. items.abstract: Color defect centers carrying electron spins in solid crystals like diamond and silicon carbide (SiC) are promising candidates for qubits and quantum sensors, with SiC material being particularly interesting due to its compatibility with the existing semiconductor technology. Here we investigated the electron spin properties of silicon vacancy centers (V1 and V2) both electron spin $S = 3/2$ in 4H-SiC in the temperature range $T=80-300$~K using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR). The EPR spectrum shows central and satellite lines, where the former ones originate from V1 and V2 centers, as well as from unknown defect center X. The analysis of continuous wave EPR measurements revealed a spin concentration of $c_{\mathrm{V1}}=1.47\pm0.3\times10^{14}$, $c_{\mathrm{V2}}=5.6\pm1.12\times10^{13}$ and $c_{\mathrm{X}}=1.03\pm0.21\times10^{13}$ spins/cm$^{3}$. items.title: Design, Testing and Calibration of the GAPS Experiment Si(Li) Tracker Readout ASIC: From the First Flight Campaign Toward the Second Mission Upgrade
items.abstract: The General Antiparticle Spectrometer (GAPS) is a balloon-borne experiment designed to perform three long-duration flights from Antarctica to search for low-energy cosmic antinuclei, in particular antideuterons, as an indirect signature of dark matter. Its detection method relies on the formation and decay of exotic atoms, identified through the emission of characteristic x-rays and the subsequent annihilation into secondary particles. At the core of the instrument is the silicon tracker, composed of lithium-drifted silicon detectors operated at -40°C and read out by a custom application-specific integrated circuit, SLIDER32, implemented in 180 nm CMOS technology. This thesis reports on the integration, calibration, and validation of the SLIDER32-based tracker readout electronics. Certified minimax normal-scale mixtures for the logistic-normal integral
items.abstract: The logistic distribution function is a scale mixture of normal distribution functions, and Monahan and Stefanski approximate it by the $K$-term mixture $Λ(x) \approx \sum_{i} w_i Φ(s_i x)$ chosen to minimise the uniform error on the real line. Each such mixture reduces the logistic-normal integral to a sum of $K$ normal distribution functions with the mixture's uniform error bound. This integral is the expectation of a logistic sigmoid over a normal distribution in statistics and the Gauss-Fermi integral in semiconductor physics. Monahan and Stefanski tabulate constants for $K \le 8$ and conjecture that the optimal error equioscillates at $2K$ points, while above $K = 8$ the Remez exchange and local solvers stall at nonequioscillating stationary points. We prove that the tangent space of the mixture family is a Chebyshev system, which forces $2K$-point equioscillation at every interior...

items.title: First-principles phase diagram of monolayer CrS$_2$ polymorphs under biaxial strain and its sensitivity to the Hubbard U parameter
items.abstract: In correlated two-dimensional magnets the balance between competing electronic and magnetic phases is often set by the strength of the on-site Coulomb interaction, so that the predicted ground state can hinge on a parameter that is not uniquely defined. Monolayer CrS$_2$ lies squarely in this regime, hosting several energetically close polymorphs whose character ranges from non-magnetic semiconducting to magnetically ordered metallic. We therefore investigate, using DFT$+U$ within the generalized gradient approximation, the structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the 1H, 1T, 1T$'$, and 1T$''$ polymorphs of monolayer CrS$_2$ under varying Hubbard interactions ($U=0$--$8$~eV) and biaxial strain ($-10\%$ to $+10\%$). items.title: N-Polar AlGaN/GaN Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor
items.abstract: Heterojunction bipolar transistors based on the III-Nitride systems have significantly lower performance than field effect transistors due to challenges associated with p-type doping of the base. N-polar AlGaN/GaN HBTs can overcome these challenges by polarization-induced holes in the base and base-emitter interface. We experimentally demonstrate the first N-polar AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs) grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy on GaN substrate without emitter regrowth. The HBTs exhibit a peak current gain of approximately 15, peak differential current gain of approximately 18, and emitter-area-normalized peak current densities exceeding 20 kA/cm^2 and 66 kA/cm^2 for emitter areas of 10 x 10 um^2 and 3 x 10 um^2, respectively. The specific contact resistance for base is estimated 1.32 x 10^{-2} Ohm.cm^2. The open-base breakdown voltage is characterized...

items.title: Real-Time AI Acceleration on a 2D Spatial Dataflow Architecture
items.abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly being integrated into real-time systems, which makes the timing analysis of ML accelerators necessary. However, the most popular commercial accelerator, the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU), remains difficult to analyze as several aspects of its behavior, including scheduling of threads involved in single-instruction multiple-thread computations and memory access latency, are not fully documented. Spatial dataflow accelerators present an interesting alternative to GPUs, as they inherently support compute and memory partitioning. Data movement and computation locality are explicitly controlled by the programmer. In this work, we consider the Tenstorrent Blackhole, which is based on a commodity RISC-V architecture. It consists of a 2D grid of cores connected by Networks-on-Chip (NoCs), supporting a fully open software runtime. We profile the Blackhole pl...

items.title: Neural-operator acceleration of bidirectional phonon Boltzmann-Fourier coupling for multiscale heat transport in silicon fin arrays
items.abstract: Localized heating in semiconductor devices can produce non-diffusive phonon transport near heat-generating regions, while heat spreading through the surrounding substrate remains well described by Fourier conduction. We present a hybrid framework that couples a pretrained neural operator for the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) within individual fins to a Fourier model of a shared substrate. To reduce the cost of repeated BTE solves across fin positions and coupling iterations, a DeepONet maps each fin's substrate-interface temperature and heating state to its temperature and heat-flux fields. The operator is trained on interface temperatures generated by a linearized proxy of the coupled problem, which avoids explicit training data collection from full coupled runs. items.title: Resilience of Entangling Gates to Spatiotemporally Correlated Noise
items.abstract: As quantum processors scale, spatially and temporally correlated noise is emerging as a limiting factor in the fidelity of multiqubit gates. Here we show that this makes the choice of entangling operation a first-order design decision: for two-qubit gates in semiconductor spin qubits, the CZ and $\sqrt{\mathrm{iSWAP}}$ gates exhibit a pronounced resilience to correlated noise relative to the SWAP gate, even though correlated fluctuations of the entangling interaction can degrade gate performance to a level comparable to that of local noise. We trace this hierarchy to the redistribution of noise-sensitive channels away from zero frequency and show it to hold for noise spectra dominated by low-frequency weight, including $1/f$ and Lorentzian. items.title: Generalized dielectric-dependent hybrid functional combining Gaussian and Yukawa screening
items.abstract: We develop a generalized Coulomb-attenuated method (GCAM) for dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals that combines Gaussian and Yukawa-type screening functions to provide an accurate representation of the random-phase approximation (RPA) dielectric function. Through systematic fitting to RPA dielectric functions of semiconductors and insulators, and to the Lindhard dielectric function of the homogeneous electron gas, we demonstrate that GCAM significantly reduces errors in the model dielectric function across the full momentum range. However, despite this improved physical description of screening, band gap calculations reveal that GCAM yields larger errors compared to experiment than previous CAM approaches for wide-gap materials, but smaller errors for most narrow-gap materials. items.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors offer a viable platform for next-generation electronics beyond sub-3 nm nodes, yet essential nonlinear circuit elements, such as thyristors, remain unexplored on atomically thin platforms. Here, we report an atomically thin reconfigurable electro-optical thyristor based on a lateral WSe2-MoSe2-WSe2-MoSe2 PNPN heterostructure, directly grown via sequential edge epitaxy. Unlike single-junction 2D diodes, this multijunction architecture exhibits thyristor-like nonlinear switching, including forward blocking, abrupt snapback, bistability, and electrical latching. The device exhibits a forward-blocking voltage of 183 V, corresponding to a critical electric field of 1 MV/cm. items.title: Numerical simulations of CCP-2D GEC with sGMRES
items.abstract: Fluid models provide an efficient means of simulating the low-temperature gas discharges, which are important in semiconductor manufacturing. This work presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first systematic numerical framework for the Gaseous Electronics Conference (GEC) reference cell of the 2D capacitively coupled plasma (CCP). The framework employs a structured, nonuniform cylindrical mesh to resolve the spatial gradients. A semi-implicit Scharfetter-Gummel (SG) scheme is used for the Poisson's equation, while the implicit SG schemes are applied to the continuity equations and the electron energy equation. Both the explicit and and the implicit formulations based on the conventional drift-diffusion terms are also investigated. items.title: Indentation-induced polar domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave semiconductor EuTe4
items.abstract: Controlling polar domains in conducting materials by external fields could unlock polarization-based electronic functionalities, yet remains experimentally challenging. While mechanical actuation driven by local strain, stress, or strain gradients has been proposed as an external-voltage-free route, its experimental demonstration in relatively conducting polar materials remains limited. Here we demonstrate mechanically induced polar-domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave (CDW) semiconductor EuTe4 at room temperature, whose resistivity is on the order of 10 m$Ω$cm. Polarized-light microscopy and second-harmonic-generation measurements reveal CDW-induced in-plane polarization domains with an approximately 90 $^\circ$ domain configuration. items.title: Proposal for a cat-cluster-state machine gun
items.abstract: Non-Gaussian bosonic states such as the Schrödinger cat states are essential for continuous-variable quantum-information processing. A convenient and deterministic process for generating cat states is through the use of a Rabi interaction between a single bosonic mode and a spin which facilitates a state-dependent displacement. The lack of a Rabi interaction for propagating optical photons has rendered optical cat states elusive. Here, we show that the complex nonlinear scattering dynamics of a single-mode squeezed-vacuum state interacting with a quantum emitter can be engineered to produce a Rabi interaction between a quantum emitter and a propagating photon mode while the contributions from other orthogonal modes destructively interfere. items.title: Population of spin orbit-split-electron branches in semimetallic HgTe quantum wells
items.abstract: We present the results of experimental studies on magnetoresistance, the Hall effect, and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations performed in gated heterostructures with HgTe-based gapless semiconductor quantum wells. We show that in quantum wells with widths corresponding to a semimetallic charge carrier spectrum, electrons, in contrast to the idealized model, populate both spin-orbit-split branches of the spectrum. This occurs regardless of whether the Fermi level lies exclusively in the conduction band or within the conduction-valence band overlap region.

items.title: AgenticMM: A Material-Centered Multi-Agent Architecture for Scalable First-Principles Materials Modeling
items.abstract: Multi-agent frameworks are attracting increasing attention as a means of autonomously driving complex, long-running workflows in first-principles materials modeling. However, such frameworks commonly organize AI agents by computational task or scientific role. When scaled across many materials, this organization can require repeated transfers of material-specific context and complicate persistent execution and resource coordination. Here, we introduce AgenticMM, a material-centered multi-agent architecture in which each material has a persistent agent that owns its complete workflow and retains its scientific context, while a persistent coordinator allocates shared resources, mediates communication, and tracks campaign progress. items.title: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
items.abstract: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations. items.title: Learning in the Passive Space: End-to-End Muti-Order Port-Hamiltonian Macromodeling
items.abstract: Compact, passive state-space macromodels of interconnects and power-delivery networks are essential for stable transient signal- and power-integrity simulations. However, conventional flows require costly per-layout full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulations, while both traditional fitting and prior learning surrogates rely on post-hoc fitting or passivity perturbation that degrades accuracy without guaranteeing convergence. In this work, we propose an end-to-end macromodeling framework that learns directly in the passive space, mapping physical layout graphs to multi-order port-Hamiltonian (pH) macromodels. items.title: First-Principles Investigation of the {ScSe2} TMDs Monolayer: Structural Stability, Electronic and Optical Properties
items.abstract: We present an ab initio investigation of the {ScSe2} monolayer using density functional theory (DFT), as employed in the CP2K code, to assess its structural stability and electronic properties. The electronic behavior of both phases is governed by the local coordination environment of scandium and the associated lifting of degeneracy of its $3d$ orbitals. The valence bands (VBs) are dominated by {Se}$-4p$ states in both phases, while the states near the Fermi level distinguish the metallic 1T phase from the semiconducting 2H phase. Optical response calculations reveal markedly different spectral signatures for the two polymorphs. Two findings emerge from this study: a polymorphism-driven metal-to-semiconductor transition without any change in chemical composition and distinct optical responses relevant to phase-selective optoelectronic devices.

items.title: CHARMS250V1: A Cryogenic Front-End ASIC for Low-Noise Readout of Charge or Light Signals in Noble Liquid Detectors
items.abstract: This work presents the design and measurement results of CHARMS250V1, a next-generation cryogenic front-end application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) developed using a 65 nm CMOS process. It is designed for low-noise readout of charge or light signals generated in noble liquid detectors. CHARMS250V1 is a single channel prototype whose design in the future will be integrated within a 16-channel ASIC. It comprises pre-amplification and pulse shaping stages that provide programmable charge gain between 4.3 mV/fC and 25 mV/fC, peaking time programmable between 250 ns and 2 us, and programmable baseline of either 200 mV or 900 mV for processing of unipolar and bipolar signals, respectively.

items.title: Metal to Semiconductor Transition in Niobium Sulfoselenide Alloy Films by Compositional Control
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have garnered significant interest due to their tunable bandgaps, optical anisotropy, and mechanical flexibility. This study explores the relationship between stoichiometry, structural phase, and electronic transport in niobium sulfoselenide (NbSxSe2-x) thin films. In this study, low-dimensional TMD films were grown with molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) to investigate the effects of varying chalcogen (sulfur and selenium) content in NbSxSe2-x alloys. We focus on tuning electrical resistivity along with the transition from metallic-to-semiconducting behavior through compositional control. These MBE grown films were characterized using in-vacuo x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to analyze the chemical composition. items.title: Optical Scintillation Imaging for Dynamic Source Tracking Dosimetry During Prostate HDR Brachytherapy
items.abstract: High-dose-rate (HDR) brachytherapy is highly conformal, but its accuracy depends on catheter and source placement, and clinical workflows lack real-time in vivo dosimetry (IVD) that verifies delivery without disrupting the procedure. We characterize a scintillator-based optical dosimeter integrated into a transrectal probe that tracks source position, speed, dose rate, and time-resolved cumulative dose. A 67 mm x 5 mm line scintillator is imaged by a CMOS camera through a 30-degree endoscopic lens; geometric and flat-field corrections remove barrel distortion and vignetting. Absolute dose was calibrated with a TOPAS Monte Carlo model of the probe's air-cavity geometry. The system was validated in a water phantom with an Ir-192 source and needles at radial offsets of 7, 10, and 15 mm. items.title: Physical Learning for Autonomous Tuning of Spin Qubits in Electrostatically Defined Quantum Dots
items.abstract: Tuning electrostatically defined quantum dots remains a primary bottleneck in the scalability of semiconductor spin qubits. While existing solutions rely on machine learning algorithms, these approaches require global information, introduce latency bottlenecks, and tax the limited cooling power available at cryogenic stages. Here, we demonstrate an FPGA-in-the-loop learning paradigm that bypasses digital computing overhead by utilizing multiplexed gradient descent (MGD) for tuning. Implemented on an FPGA and an emulated quantum dot device, our system autonomously tracks environmental drift, dynamically recovers from discrete charge jumps, and maintains steady-state stabilization in low signal-to-noise ratio regimes, without prior knowledge of the device's cross-capacitance matrix. items.title: Coherence Lengths of Laser Pointers
items.abstract: We report on the coherence lengths of low-cost green laser pointers in the midst of multimodal behavior using an optical interferometer based on noncollinear beam geometries and a CMOS detector array. Examined devices include three diode lasers and a frequency-doubled neodymium-emission diode-pumped solid state (DPSS) laser. Coherence length measurements are variable among devices, but values can nevertheless regularly exceed 10 cm. The work serves as a template for an advanced undergraduate physics laboratory experiment and may inspire new kinds of laser pointer devices utilizing interference effects as operative principles.

items.title: Specification-Grounded Adaptive Triage and Formal Invariant Exclusion Synthesis for Autonomous Silicon Coverage Closure
items.abstract: Closing the final 5%-15% of code and functional coverage remains a major schedule bottleneck in silicon tapeouts. Existing LLM-based coverage closure loops feed raw uncovered RTL lines or branches directly into iterative prompts, failing on industrial subsystems due to: (1) token and context explosion from querying thousands of correlated holes independently; (2) illegal stimulus that violates cross-signal invariants and yields dirty coverage; and (3) unsafe exclusion hallucination on structurally unreachable dead code. We present ARGUS (Autonomous Reachability & Guided Unified Stimulus), a specification-grounded, dual-regime coverage closure and formal exclusion synthesis engine. items.abstract: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. items.title: Topology-Enabled Self-Verification of Quantum Hall Resistance Standards
items.abstract: The scaling of multi-element quantized Hall array resistance standards necessitates rigorous validation that internal quantization has not broken down without relying on the verification of dissipationless edge state transport. One proposed solution is to use a Symmetric Precision Quantization Reliability criterion, a mathematical framework that statistically assures such validation strictly through outer terminal measurements of Cn-symmetric designs. This criterion essentially bounds the likelihood of hidden localized defects arising from quantum Hall breakdown and has potential uses in quantum computing and semiconductor testing but is presented in the context of its application toward quantum electrical standards.

items.title: Design and Modeling of Graded Base III-Nitride HBTs for High-Frequency Applications
items.abstract: This work analyzes the high-frequency performance constraints of AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs) and proposes a novel band-engineered graded base N-polar AlGaN/GaN HBT and evaluates the RF performances. Unlike conventional p-GaN base designs, we propose a graded base in the N-polar orientation which offers polarization-induced hole accumulation with quasi-electric field-assisted minority carrier transport. The proposed design simultaneously mitigates the longstanding current crowding, Webster effect, and conventional base resistance limitations. Using well-calibrated two-dimensional TCAD simulations, the proposed compositionally graded base HBT projects peak f_T/f_{MAX} of 190/200 GHz with a power density (V_{BR}I_{MAX}/8 > 20 W/mm), offering a promising pathway toward simultaneous high-frequency and high-power GaN millimeter-wave electronics.

items.title: Optical readout of MicroPattern Gaseous Detectors with SiPMs
items.abstract: Scintillation light readout of MicroPattern Gaseous Detectors (MPGDs) is used for imaging and track reconstruction applications including in optical Time Projection Chambers (TPC). Typically, high resolution CCD or CMOS imaging sensors are used and PMTs can be employed to obtain auxiliary timing information. We report on the optical readout of MPGDs with Silicon Photomultipliers (SiPMs) which enables limited spatial resolution. Arrays of SiPMs were used to read out Gaseous Electron Multipliers (GEMs) and Glass Micromegas amplification stages. Center of gravity reconstruction of hit positions yields a spatial resolution of approximately 1.35 mm for signals shared across multiple SiPMs. High gain of the amplification stage as well as the SiPMs enables good signal sharing and is advantageous for position reconstruction.

items.title: Reliable arithmetic circuits using less reliable (sub-digital) logic
items.abstract: The frequent static failure of CMOS logic gates at ultra-low voltages has historically been perceived as a strict barrier to extreme voltage scaling: this paper introduces a statistical circuit law proving this intuition wrong. We discovered a universal power law connecting gate and circuit static failure probabilities, revealing that circuit failure requires the simultaneous breakdown of an entire gate cluster rather than a single component. Because the required cluster size increases rapidly as voltage drops, low-voltage \textit{sub-digital} logic exhibits surprising inherent resilience to static failure. This insight stems from new theoretical tools we developed to quantify static failure, extending well beyond conventional voltage-margin analysis. Consequently, sub-digital processors could potentially offer a viable, near-term solution to drastically reduce the energy demands of AI.

items.title: Ultrafast Successive Control and Electrical Detection of Long-Lived Valley Polarization in Room-Temperature Germanium
items.abstract: Germanium (Ge) hosts four degenerate valleys in the conduction band minima, and their highly anisotropic effective masses offer a valley degree of freedom in transport phenomena via anisotropic conductivity. Using time- and polarization-resolved terahertz spectroscopy combined with deformation potential theory, we reveal a valley relaxation time reaching 10 ps near the band edge of Ge(001) at room temperature, long enough to detect the valley polarization in electrical transport measurements. We also demonstrate sub-picosecond complete reversal of valley polarization by off-resonant light pulses at extremely low energy consumption. These results pave the way for room-temperature valleytronics based on bulk indirect-gap semiconductors compatible with existing electronics.

items.title: Fault-tolerant quantum processor with minimal external control
items.abstract: Contemporary classical information processors integrate tens of billions of transistors printed on a chip, yet are fully controlled through comparatively few external wires. This is possible because data flows through hard-coded operations in step with a global clock and is steered by external instructions. Today's solid-state quantum processors are different -- every qubit receives instructions from outside the chip via its own dedicated control line, and error correction adds a further torrent of syndrome data that is transported off-chip. Here we show that the external control of a quantum chip can be greatly simplified. We propose a fault-tolerant architecture for universal quantum computation, inspired by modern classical processors, in which quantum information flows through a fixed, clocked device, propelled by local gates in a planar array. items.abstract: This work presents a novel computer-aided design (CAD) tool for gradient-based circuit optimization using SPICE and automatic differentiation, which we term ADSPICE. items.title: Near-Quantum-Limited Readout for the Princeton Axion Search using a sub-GHz Kinetic Inductance Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
items.abstract: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. The system noise performance, as measured by a variable-temperature noise source, is 2.5-3.5 quanta. This device is a versatile new tool for precision measurements of sub-GHz signals, with applications including readout of semiconductor spin qubits, superconducting detector arrays, and searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model. We characterize aspects of the amplifier performance relevant to axion searches, including gain drift, compression point, amplifier noise at various operating temperatures, readout with an input circulator, and magnetic field inse...

items.title: FrontierMat: Benchmarking Language Models at the Frontier of Materials R&D
items.abstract: To accelerate materials discovery, language models must be able to address problems at the research frontier. Yet textbook- and examination-derived benchmarks primarily assess established knowledge, leaving performance on frontier research problems largely untested. We introduce FrontierMat, a benchmark of 330 problems drawn from frontier academic and industrial research in fields including aerospace, semiconductors, embodied intelligence and nuclear fusion. Every problem is validated by leading experimentalists and industry experts in its field. Each problem presents a real study and asks the model to infer a withheld outcome or draw a conclusion from selected experimental evidence. Problems are annotated by functional domain, material system and the scale of the governing mechanism; 130 require cross-scale reasoning. The strongest general-purpose model scores only 53.7%, and on matched...

items.title: I$_4$ complex acting as near-infrared emitter with a quantum memory in silicon
items.abstract: Silicon color centers emitting in the near infrared offer a route to spin--photon interfaces compatible with mature complementary metal--oxide--semiconductor fabrication. A key unresolved candidate is the X-line at 1039.7 meV in the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum, long attributed to a complex of four self-interstitials (I$_4$), yet whose microscopic structure and spin properties have remained controversial and uncharacterized at a predictive level. Using hybrid-functional (HSE06) density functional theory, we unambiguously establish the bare I$_4$ complex as the origin of the X-line: our calculations quantitatively reproduce the zero-phonon line, the complete phonon sideband structure---identifying the prominent secondary peaks as one- and two-phonon replicas of strongly coupled quasi-local modes---and the EPR hyperfine constants. The charge transition level is found at VBM$+$0.08~eV, c...

items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. Unlike approaches based primarily on phenomenological leakage models, our first-principles, multi-terminal quantum-tran...

items.title: BROAD: Bit-Parallel Row-Oriented Arithmetic in DRAM
items.abstract: Processing-using-memory (PUM) architectures perform computation directly within DRAM to reduce costly data movement between memory and processors. Because charge-sharing operations are confined to individual bitlines, existing DRAM-PUM architectures reorganize data into column-oriented, bit-serial representations. This organization is fundamentally incompatible with the row-oriented, word-parallel layouts used by conventional processors and accelerators, requiring expensive data-layout transformations whenever computation transitions between PUM and conventional execution. In this paper, we present BROAD, or Bit-Parallel Row-Oriented Arithmetic in DRAM. BROAD augments the DRAM subarray with two lightweight extensions: migration cells that enable localized horizontal data movement between neighboring bitlines and inversion cells that provide efficient in-array logical inversion. These pri...

items.title: SPLASH: Co-Designing Flash-Aware Sparse Attention with a Virtualized HBM-HBF Hierarchy
items.abstract: As context lengths, request lifetimes and concurrency grow, the key-value (KV) cache dominates memory usage in large language model (LLM) inference. High-bandwidth memory (HBM), the memory on contemporary GPUs, achieves far higher bandwidth than off-package memory, yet its capacity, bounded by DRAM density, has not kept pace with this demand. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF), an emerging memory technology, bridges this gap, combining the advanced packaging of HBM with the density of flash to deliver terabyte-scale capacity at HBM-class read bandwidth. Exploiting this capacity for long-context KV caches, however, requires hiding the vastly different physical characteristics of flash from the GPU while keeping decode interactive. We therefore introduce Splash, an architecture that virtualizes HBM and HBF for the KV cache. We architect custom HBM and HBF base dies with novel memory and flash cont...

items.title: Probing proximity-induced superconductivity in bilayer graphene using gate-defined quantum dots
items.abstract: Van der Waals heterostructures enable the combination of two-dimensional (2D) materials with different electronic properties in a single device. Bilayer graphene (BLG) is particularly attractive as its electrically tunable band gap enables local control of tunnel barriers and quantum dots (QDs). Here, we realize an all-2D hybrid platform based on BLG proximitized by superconducting NbSe$_2$. Using electrostatic gates, we define tunnel barriers and QDs at different distances from the superconductor-semiconductor interface. The QDs serve as local spectroscopic probes of the proximitized BLG channel, forming tunable superconductor-quantum dot-normal conductor junctions. Coulomb blockade and finite-bias spectroscopy reveal a proximity-induced superconducting gap of up to $80\,\mathrm{μeV}$ and allow to track its evolution with distance from the NbSe$_2$ contact. The local density of states r...

items.title: Continuous-Wave Operation at 30 MV/m of a Superconducting Radio-Frequency Gun Cryomodule with an Exchangeable Cathode Plug
items.abstract: A prototype 185.7 MHz superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) electron gun cryomodule has been developed for the proposed LCLS-II-HE Low Emittance Injector at SLAC. It has an in-situ ultra-high-vacuum exchangeable cathode plug system compatible with semiconductor photocathodes. With a copper plug, the gun achieved continuous-wave RF operation at a cathode field of 30 MV/m. No measurable degradation was observed after plug removal and reinsertion with the cavity at 4.4 K. This result is a significant improvement over past continuous-wave SRF gun systems with exchangeable plugs.

items.title: Heteroepitaxial Growth of PbSe on InP via III-V Buffer Layers
items.abstract: Detector cost remains a barrier to the widespread adoption of mid-wave infrared (3-5 micron) technology. PbSe, an inexpensive narrow band gap IV-VI semiconductor that has been used since the early 1940s, delivers high performance for infrared detection despite the abundance of grain boundaries in polycrystalline films. Epitaxial growth, however, could provide superior crystalline quality and interfaces, but suitable substrates remain limited for PbSe. Recent PbSe heteroepitaxy has focused primarily on III-V, II-VI and group-IV substrates that each offer a comparatively narrow range of lattice-matched alloys for heterostructure engineering. Here we show that InP-based heteroepitaxy provides access to a broader materials platform while limiting the lattice mismatch with PbSe to approximately 4%. items.title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
items.abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the $0$--$π$ transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable $π$-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. items.title: OpenTherm: A Unified and Progressive Benchmark for 2.5D/3D-IC Thermal Prediction
items.abstract: Accurate and efficient chip thermal prediction is essential for advanced packaging design. In recent years, deep learning-based thermal predictors have made significant progress, achieving high prediction accuracy while substantially reducing computational costs. However, differences in datasets, simulators, and evaluation protocols hinder direct comparison of existing methods and systematic assessment of their generalization across design variations and cross-package transfer scenarios. We introduce OpenTherm, an open benchmark combining 32,000 established 3D-IC samples with 50,000 new 2.5D chiplet samples generated with the open-source HotSpot simulator. It provides fixed data splits, a common input representation, and shared evaluation tools. Five deployment-aligned Generalization Scopes cover fixed-design workload prediction, within-family layout, material, and cooling exploration, a...

items.title: Dual-Mode Exciton Coupling in Epitaxially Registered Organic-Inorganic 2D Heterocrystals
items.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) heterocrystals comprising molecules and semiconductors can serve as an ideal platform for studying interfacial excitons and for future optoelectronic applications, yet the energy and charge flow across these atomically sharp interfaces remain unclear. In this work, we investigated PTCDA-MoS2 as a prototypical 2D organic-inorganic heterostructure and revealed dual-mode exciton coupling between the constituent crystals. Monolayer-resolved PTCDA molecular crystals were grown on monolayer MoS2 via physical vapor assembly, and their crystallographic details, including the stacking angle, were determined by electron diffraction. Upon the formation of the heterostructures, PTCDA's photoluminescence was completely quenched because of organic-to-inorganic hole transfer, whereas that of MoS2 increased markedly with PTCDA thickness. Using differential reflectance and photolumin...

items.title: First-principles carrier mobility and optical absorption of strained ZnO with self-consistent Hubbard interactions
items.abstract: Carrier mobility and optical absorption are key performance parameters of oxide semiconductors in transparent and flexible displays. We use a newly developed density-functional perturbation theory with a self-consistent Hubbard correction (DFPT+U) to study phonon-limited electron transport and phonon-assisted optical absorption in strained zinc oxide (ZnO). This parameter-free approach accounts for electron-phonon interactions and on-site correlation effects simultaneously. Electronic structures and phonon dispersions are computed under three distinct uniaxial strain directions. Uniaxial tensile strain up to 4.8% along [\bar110] is found to increase the room-temperature electron mobility by 19% while leaving visible-range optical absorption essentially unchanged. These results demonstrate that moderate strain can selectively enhance carrier transport without degrading optical transparenc...

items.title: Direct visualization of charge dynamics by Pockels imaging in optoelectronics
items.abstract: Understanding charge dynamics in optoelectronic devices is essential because it governs carrier transport, signal evolution, and device performance. Yet, experimental access to the spatiotemporal evolution of charge remains limited. Here, we introduce Carrier Dynamics by Pockels Imaging (CDPI), a sensitive, quantitative, and non-invasive pump-probe technique based on the linear electro-optic (Pockels) effect. CDPI images the electric-field wave associated with traveling photogenerated carriers and reveals the evolution of charge clouds in space and time. This provides direct access to fundamental transport processes, including drift, diffusion, carrier-carrier interactions, trapping, and detrapping. Furthermore, the internal conduction- and displacement-current profiles are obtained from the electric-field dynamics and shown to be consistent with the externally measured current transient...

items.title: 2D Transport in an in-plane magnetic field
items.abstract: A parallel in-plane magnetic field could, in principle, distinguish between two competing physical scenarios for the experimentally observed density-tuned 2D metal-insulator transition (where decreasing the carrier density leads to a crossover from an effective metal to an effective insulator): Wigner crystallization or Anderson localization. Since the main scattering mechanism in 2D doped semiconductors arises from screened random charged impurities and screening in turn depends on the electronic density of states, the in-plane magnetic field could distinguish between the two by decreasing screening through spin polarization and this enhances the effective critical density for Anderson localization compared with Wigner crystallization.
